LanguageData.Gun_Ithaca_37_Riot_RWP.label: Ithaca 37 Riot
LanguageData.Gun_Ithaca_37_Riot_RWP.description: The Ithaca 37 Riot is a pump-action shotgun known for its reliability and durable construction. Ideal for close-quarters combat, it offers significant stopping power and has a fast pump action that ensures quick follow-up shots. Its rugged design makes it a favorite among security forces and anyone in need of a dependable weapon for riot control or self-defense situations.
